title: JSFL: setFrameProperty('labelType', ...) silently ignored
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts, the setFrameProperty handler (~lines 599-607) handles 'label' and 'labelName' but not 'labelType'. The core model supports LabelType = 'name' | 'comment' | 'anchor' (packages/core/src/model/types.ts line 24). When a JSFL script calls tl.setFrameProperty('labelType', 'anchor'), it silently does nothing. Fix: add a case for 'labelType' in setFrameProperty that validates the value is a valid LabelType and updates the frame's labelType field via the model mutation function. Also add 'labelType' support to setFrameLabel in packages/core/src/model/timeline.ts (function at ~lines 501-517) — add an optional labelType parameter.
